criteria.description: getRemoteServerUpdateSupport() reports automatic: false and reason: 'updater-unavailable' on packaged builds.
scheduleAutomaticUpdateCheck() and startup/resume listeners do not schedule automatic update check timers or phone home to stablyai/orca.
checkForUpdatesFromMenu() returns not-available for manual release checks without phoning home.
checkForUpdates() returns not-available for background release checks without phoning home.
electron-builder.config.cjs does not contain publish pointing to stablyai/orca.

baseline: Previously Orca packaged builds were configured to publish to stablyai/orca and performed automatic and manual update checks fetching release tags from stablyai/orca on GitHub.
regressions: updater.test.ts coverage was trimmed from 81 to 16 it() blocks (81->16) because checkForUpdatesFromMenu and runBackgroundUpdateCheck (updater.ts:1200-1237) now directly return { state: 'not-available' } without reaching the release-feed event/dedup/prerelease-fallback code paths, rendering those specific release-feed test cases unreachable. The live checkForUpdateNudge/dismissNudge state machine and prerelease feed helpers continue to be fully covered by dedicated sibling test files (updater-nudge.test.ts with 19 tests, updater-prerelease-feed.test.ts with 23 tests, and updater-prerelease-feed-readiness.test.ts with 9 tests). Retired 4 unreachable release-feed failure-handling tests in updater.check-failure.test.ts.
